title: Human-only: apply the spec 1.1 patch, then re-pin contracts

remediations.why: Spec 1.1 edits packages/spec/schema/incubator.schema.json, a pinned contract. pnpm contracts:pin is a human-only action, and the pre-push hook (check:quick) rightly refuses a commit that fails contracts-pin, so the change is delivered as a patch.
remediations.verified: applied to a fresh checkout of the branch head, pnpm check:quick fails on contracts-pin only (1 finding)
